reserveReview.rationale: KPMG's unmodified reasonable-assurance report signed October 23, 2026 gives $1,670,239,383 of BNY Dreyfus Government Cash Management shares, $3,895,071 of BNY Mellon U.S. Treasury Fund shares, $3,885,100 of BlackRock ICS U.S. Treasury Fund shares, $1,412,278,860 of Treasury bills, $78,124,993 of cash and no repurchase agreements against $3,168,423,407 of total redemption assets at September 30, 2026, 17:00 EDT (the report's earlier September 17 column is not used). The seven native-chain redeemable liabilities in Exhibit A, now including Mantle, sum to 3,164,996,248 and agree with Exhibit C; no timing adjustments or nonredeemable tokens are reported. The latest listed Treasury maturity is November 5, 2026, 36 days after the composition date. Percentages are rounded to two decimals from the reported amounts. The BlackRock Banking Circle Dis USD KIID, accurate as at September 25, 2026 and retrieved October 10, limits underlying investments to 397 days until full principal repayment, distinct from the 60-day weighted-average maturity and 120-day weighted-average life. These are underlying portfolio constraints, not a finite repayment maturity for the open-ended fund shares held by USDG. No money-market-fund slice receives a numeric maturityDaysMax from those constraints; the existing exact aggregate open-ended maturity-applicability review remains authoritative.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The KPMG-examined report confirms segregated, unencumbered accounts held on behalf of USDG token holders, and the Paxos USD Stablecoin terms (sections 1.1.1, 3.1.2, 3.2.2.1) contractually commit PDS/PIE to hold reserves in segregated custodial accounts apart from corporate funds, on behalf of and for the benefit of token holders; the MAS Letter of Undertaking adds regulatory safeguarding requirements and MiCA/EMD2 statutory safeguarding covers the small PIE-held share. No trust or SPV structure is documented for the PDS-held bulk, and the terms' explicit bankruptcy-remote statement covers only Paxos Trust Company-issued coins, so remoteness stays contractual-only. Rehypothecation is conditional: the examined criterion requires unencumbered redemption assets and the report prohibits selling or repledging repo collateral, but rehypothecation terms for cash deposits are not established. The report anonymizes the commercial banks and the qualified Treasury custodian.
